title: Sydney Opera House — New Year’s Eve 2026 visitor arrangements

facts.fact: The Opera House explicitly identifies the 2026 edition, separates paid events from the free Forecourt and requires a booking for the free Forecourt.
facts.excerpt: This year we are ticketing the Forecourt to make it easier for people to access the site. It's still free but bookings are essential.
facts.location: Plan your visit, following New Year’s Eve 2026 event listings

facts.fact: Paid-event access is via Macquarie Street during its own entry window; screenshots are not accepted, and entry after the advertised cutoff is denied.
facts.excerpt: All tickets will be scanned on Macquarie Street, prior to entry to the Sydney Opera House site. Screenshots of tickets will not be accepted.
facts.location: Important information for paid ticketed events

notes: Official document actually captured and read on the recorded date.
